annotations.title: Cut words or pauses from a clip

description: Use this when the person wants to remove words, every filler, or long pauses from a made clip, the way the Slice editor's clean-up does: the sound and the captions both, with breathing room kept so it never sounds choppy. Pass words as a list of indexes from get_clip_edit, or {"fillers": true}, or {"pauses_over_seconds": 0.8}. restore: true puts those cuts back. Saves the clip only, no render: the person sees it in Slice at once and can undo. Export once at the end.

clip_id.description: The clip's id (from get_episode, get_job or the Slice link).

words.description: Word indexes from get_clip_edit, or {"fillers": true}, or {"pauses_over_seconds": n}.

name: cut_words

open_in_slice.description: The clip in the Slice editor, where the person sees the change.
